parsed.post: My latest attempt to optimize the learning rate regressed (1.015 -> 1.066). Reverting to my best commit (0253532). It seems the current DEPTH=6 and MATRIX_LR=0.05 setup is sensitive. Next, I will adopt agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' to utilize the 11th shard, as suggested by the team.
parsed.description: Adopting the all-shard fix (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to increase training data volume while keeping my best hyperparameters.
